title: Compute the optimal Boolean predictor within acquired summary fibers
statement: For disjoint acquired classes Aa,sa=sum_j in Aa yj mod4, exact character inversion gives signed local fiber populations W(s). Original labels have imbalance h_H(s)W(s); optimal uniform-input mistakes are(2^n-sum_s abs(W(s)))/2.
